Token Management System runs our quantum and advanced-compute programs: readiness assessments with HNDL risk clocks, solver tournaments (classical vs. quantum-inspired vs. hybrid) on your actual formulations, PQC migration with CBOM-grade discovery, HPC engineering, and the emerging-silicon watchlist.

Quanta's discipline is economic: every initiative carries a classical baseline it must beat on identical benchmarks; negative results are documented deliverables. Where solvers win, we industrialize them as services with re-solve SLAs; where they don't, you keep an improved baseline and a revisit trigger.
